title: Delphi memory entry metadata
description: The optional entry-type and date fields (specs/050 ML-1) in the frontmatter of a staged note, a lesson file or a rules file. Every field is optional; an entry without them stays valid and its kind comes from its store (rules, lessons and skills are `procedure`; a staged note is `fact` when an agent wrote it with `note` and `episode` otherwise). Other frontmatter keys (specs/001 section 5) are allowed. Implemented by `delphi-engine/src/frontmatter.rs` (`check_entry_meta`); the program also checks that `last_confirmed` and `valid_until` are not before `created`. These lines do not count toward a rules file's byte cap.
